correctness.rationale: A direct substitution reconstructs R_q(z)=1+z+(q/2)z²+(q/6)z³+(q²/24)z⁴ from source stage coefficients. On J²=−I the real and imaginary parts multiply energy by a_q²+b_q². Independence gives exact E||u_n||²=m^n||u_0||². Averaging q=1±ε reduces m−1 to θ⁴/576 times Q_s(θ²), with exact discriminant 64(1+2s−23s²−12s³). The cubic sign and Vieta positivity prove the complete cases, including ε=0 and the neutral double-root boundary. The standalone code passed 10007 deterministic checks, including exact arithmetic and direct matrix implementations; no finite tests are used to justify a universal quantifier.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete sharp stability phase diagram for a named fourth-order mixed-accuracy time integrator on the canonical conservative oscillator under a natural zero-mean relative curvature-error model. It reveals low-frequency mean-square instability for every positive perturbation, a surviving intermediate band, and a rigorous finite perturbation threshold beyond which no positive step is stable. The exact threshold is motivated by algorithmic robustness, not chosen as an arbitrary slice; the coalescence and small-error asymptotics make the finding reusable in assessment of derivative-oracle perturbations.
